recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core work is needed for this issue unless the work group wants to revisit the intentional id/URL mismatch guidance separately.
issue_request: FHIR-13256 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3. It asked to remove the ambiguous update interaction wording that said a server returns HTTP 400 if the id value is 'wrong', because missing ids should be 400 while unsupported update-as-create for a non-existing id is already handled as 405.
initial_application: The historical application appears in commits 5b2d13e6e95626f0bba1823707b14f6518a3332a and 5f78baae4ea650cd60862639a889e8bae5900458, both titled '#13256 - fix wrong note about update.id'. The first removed the ambiguous phrase; the second narrowed it to the id differing from the URL. Commit 3e6cd9de0126f86ea3ded7f240f8d027e83a96f0 later corrected the typo in that wording.
additional_context: The Jira-linked Zulip thread shows Grahame Grieve intentionally changed the text to the body id differing from the URL id instead of only deleting the phrase, and invited objections. The current source also documents CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.updateCreate and 405 Method Not Allowed when client-defined ids are not supported.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/http.html no longer contains the ambiguous phrase and already covers both the 400 missing/mismatched-id case and the 405 unsupported update-as-create case.
